chapter_title_en: The Heavenly Dao Oath and a Promise of Eternity
chapter_seo_title: Ji Ning Forces a Heavenly Dao Oath and Confesses to Nine Lotos
chapter_meta_description: After forcing a deadly Heavenly Dao oath from his rival, Chen Jin, Ji Ning makes a bold move in the aftermath, confessing his feelings to Nine Lotos and asking her to be his Dao-companion.
og_title: A Sword Immortal’s Confession: Ji Ning Wins and Wins
og_description: From a life-or-death struggle to a tender promise of eternity, Ji Ning claims victory over his rival and wins the heart of Nine Lotos.
twitter_title: Ji Ning levels up in love! 💘🔥
twitter_description: Ji Ning forces his rival to swear a Heavenly Dao oath, then turns around and asks Nine Lotos to be his Dao-companion for all eternity! A huge step for our hero!

lore_anchors.definition: An unbreakable pact sworn before the supreme laws of the universe. Violation triggers immediate, absolute punishment, such as soul annihilation.
A lifelong spiritual partner on the path of cultivation, sharing insights and supporting each other through tribulations for eternity; goes beyond romantic marriage.
A spiritual cancer formed from unresolved negative emotions like rage or jealousy. It is a major threat to a cultivator’s Dao-heart and progress.
A title for a supreme cultivator of the Sword Dao in the Black-White College, marking them as an elite among the sect.
An ancient and powerful clan that spans three commanderies, surpassing the eight great powers of Anchan Commandery.
